commits.content:
{
  "Function": {
    "prefix": "function",
    "body": [
      "function ${1:MyFunction}(): ${2:string};",
      "begin",
      "  Result := ${3:''};",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "Vytvoří funkci"
  },
  "Procedure": {
    "prefix": "procedure",
    "body": [
      "procedure ${1:MyProcedure}();",
      "begin",
      "  ${2:// code}",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "Vytvoří proceduru"
  },
  "If Then Begin": {
    "prefix": "if",
    "body": [
      "if ${1:TRUE} then",
      "begin",
      "  ${2:// code}",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "If-then-begin blok"
  },
  "Var TStringList": {
    "prefix": "var",
    "body": [
      "${1:sl}: TStringList;",
      "begin",
      "  ${1:sl} := TStringList.Create;",
      "  try",
      "    ${2:// use stringlist}",
      "    for ${3:i} := 0 to ${1:sl}.Count - 1 do",
      "    begin",
      "      ${4:// process items}",
      "    end;",
      "  finally",
      "    ${1:sl}.Free;",
      "  end;",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "TStringList proměnná s for cyklem"
  },
  "For Loop": {
    "prefix": "for",
    "body": [
      "for ${1:i} := ${2:0} to ${3:Count} - 1 do",
      "begin",
      "  ${4:// code}",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "For cyklus"
  },
  "Try Finally": {
    "prefix": "try",
    "body": [
      "try",
      "  ${1:// code}",
      "finally",
      "  ${2:// cleanup}",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "Try-finally blok"
  },
  "Try Except": {
    "prefix": "trye",
    "body": [
      "try",
      "  ${1:// code}",
      "except",
      "  on E: ${2:Exception} do",
      "  begin",
      "    ${3:// error handling}",
      "  end;",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "Try-except blok"
  },
  "Repeat Until": {
    "prefix": "repeat",
    "body": [
      "repeat",
      "  ${1:// code}",
      "until ${2:condition};"
    ],
    "description": "Repeat-until cyklus"
  },
  "While Do": {
    "prefix": "while",
    "body": [
      "while ${1:condition} do",
      "begin",
      "  ${2:// code}",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "While cyklus"
  },
  "Case Of": {
    "prefix": "case",
    "body": [
      "case ${1:variable} of",
      "  ${2:0}: begin",
      "    ${3:Result := 0;}",
      "  end;",
      "  ${4:1}: begin",
      "    ${5:Result := 1;}",
      "  end;",
      "else",
      "  ${6:// default case}",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "Case of blok"
  },
  "Begin End": {
    "prefix": "begin",
    "body": [
      "begin",
      "  ${1:// code}",
      "end;"
    ],
    "description": "Begin-end blok"
  }
}
